info.name: Hostel Management API v3.1 (roles, city admin, soft delete)
info.description: Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner). Folder 1 logs in as head office, folder 2 creates two cities, two branches, their admins and a city admin, folder 3 / 3b log in as branch admins and the city admin, folders 4-12 work inside Branch A / Branch B, 14 checks isolation, 15 and 17 test SOFT delete (nothing is removed from the database).

item.name: 1. Super Admin Login
item.description: The API creates superadmin / admin123 by itself when it starts (see README). Put the same values into the collection variables super_username / super_password.

item.name: Create city admin for City A
List city admins of City A
Who is in charge of Branch A (hierarchy)
City admin opens Branch A students (own city) -> 200
City admin opens Branch B students (other city) -> 403
City admin adds a branch in own city
City admin adds a branch in ANOTHER city -> 403
Add the same service again (link is revived)
8. Visitors (Branch A)
Same visitor comes again (user row reused)

item.description: A visitor is a users row (role visitor). The id returned by Add Visitor is the VISIT id; data.visitor_id is the visitor's user id. The same name + contact is reused.

item.name: 12. Branch B data (logged in as Branch B admin)
Add Room (same room number as Branch A is allowed)
Add Service (Branch B has its own services)
13. Network summary (what other branches may see)
Basic info of Branch B (name, address, phone)

item.description: Logged in as Branch A: you get COUNTS for every branch (rooms, free rooms, beds, free beds, students) but no names or records.

item.name: 14. Isolation checks (these are SUPPOSED to be refused)
Branch A admin opens Branch B students -> 403
Branch A admin writes into Branch B -> 403
Branch B's student through Branch A's URL -> 404
Branch A admin creates a city -> 403
Delete main student (works now: history is kept)
Same room number can be created again
16. Close a branch (head office, run last)
Branch B admin is now locked out -> 403
Branch B disappears from network overview
17. Soft delete of branches and cities (head office)
Delete City A while it has branches -> 409
